name: Sub-conductor — a conductor that conducts conductors
description: Spawn one or more sub-conductors into `.conduct`, each conducting its own scope — one level deep, guarded only by its brief.

sub-conductor.description: Use only when the user asks for nested conductors; this is the sole exception to the role doc's ban on spawning into `.conduct`. Spawn one sub-conductor, or several in one turn — one per project or independent effort. Each loads the full conductor role doc, wiki and board, and nothing past the spawn is enforced — your brief is the whole guard. Open each brief with what the session is: a sub-conductor under you, not the conductor. Then state: the project(s) it conducts and nothing else; whether it may merge, or hands each worktree back with `READY_TO_LAND <worktree>` for you to land; that it never spawns a conductor itself — this playbook is yours, not its; that it drives only sessions it spawned, never a sibling; that its wiki writes stay under its projects' `projects/<name>/`; and that hard calls come back to you via `AskUserQuestion`. After a rate-limit reset a sub-conductor may sit on a severed wake — nudge it.
